snippet.title: Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo | Official Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
Every love story begins before it starts.

Across three generations and three countries, six couples discover how love, and the wounds it leaves behind, pass from one generation to the next. Based on Farhat Ishtiaq’s bestselling novel and directed by Momina Duraid, Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo stars Mahira Khan, Ahmed Ali Akbar, Bilal Ashraf, Aamina Sheikh, Fawad Khan, Sanam Saeed, Iqra Aziz, Hania Aamir, Hamza Ali Abbasi, Maya Ali, Ahad Raza Mir, and Khushhal Khan.

Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo – All The Love Our Hearts Carry Part 1 premieres globally on Netflix on December 4, with Part 2 coming soon.

Watch on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/title/81495982

Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

snippet.title: Dune: Part Three - Exclusive Teaser Trailer (2026) Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Robert Pattinson
snippet.description:
From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.
 
Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

 The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

 Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Tanya Lapointe, Villeneuve, Cale Boyter and Joe Caracciolo, Jr., and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

 Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-winning visual effects supervisor Paul Lambert and visual effects supervisor Mag Sarnowska, Oscar-winning visual effects house DNEG, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

 Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production In Association With Image Nation Studios, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

snippet.title: That Epic Team Up Is NOT The Final Battle! AVENGERS DOOMSDAY FINAL TRAILER REACTION
snippet.description:
TO ME, MY X-MEN!!  Avengers Doomsday Final Trailer Reaction - With hype through the roof, Coy & John REACT to Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer from Marvel Studios!!
👕 Doctor Doom rides a sandworm! Grab EMPEROR DUNE, our new Avengers × Dune mashup tee 👉 https://shorturl.at/2Modm

Doctor Doom, Steve Rogers, the X-Men & Fantastic Four finally collide as we react to Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer, featuring Chris Evans returning as Steve Rogers, now living happily alongside Peggy Carter (Hayley Atwell) and their young son - that is, until the Fantastic 4 show up in search of Steve's help...

The trailer also features new looks at Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom, James Marsden’s Cyclops taking the lead & finally speaking the iconic line, “To me, my X-Men,” the Sentinels, Steve and Thor’s Mjolnir banter, and heroes from three universes joining forces. With Avengers: Secret Wars ahead, we discuss Doom’s warning about their “stolen lives,” the consequences of Avengers: Endgame, the coming multiverse incursion, and beyond!

Watch The Official Final Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wb8Tq_HD4E8

#AvengersDoomsday #AvengersDoomsdayTrailer #DoctorDoom #RobertDowneyJr #ChrisEvans #CaptainAmerica #Cyclops #XMen #FantasticFour #Avengers #Marvel #MCU #TrailerReaction #ReelRejects #AvengersSecretWars

Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo (Avengers: Infinity War, Avengers: Endgame) and written by Stephen McFeely, Avengers: Doomsday stars Robert Downey Jr. as Victor von Doom/Doctor Doom (Iron Man, Oppenheimer), Chris Evans as Steve Rogers/Captain America (The Winter Soldier, Knives Out), Hayley Atwell as Peggy Carter (Agent Carter, Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning), Chris Hemsworth as Thor (Thor: Ragnarok, Extraction), Pedro Pascal as Reed Richards/Mister Fantastic (The Last of Us, The Mandalorian), Vanessa Kirby as Sue Storm/Invisible Woman (Mission: Impossible – Fallout, Napoleon), and James Marsden as Scott Summers/Cyclops (X-Men, Sonic the Hedgehog).

Avengers: Doomsday arrives exclusively in theaters December 18, 2026!

snippet.title: Cantona: Flower of Evil | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
In UK Cinemas December 7 & 12 Only.
Including exclusive interview with Eric Cantona live from Manchester.
 

The most gifted footballer of his generation was finished. Retired in disgrace at 25, he appeared destined for permanent exile from the sport he loved.
 
Incapable of blind obedience, Eric Cantona was a libertine who bridled against conformity whenever he felt its grip tighten. The French branded him unmanageable. But the fire that burned in Eric became the spark to ignite a dynasty at Manchester United.  
 
At turns thoughtful and explosive, Cantona: Flower of Evil reveals how legendary manager Alex Ferguson channelled the brilliance of this most captivating and unpredictable of athletes. A tale of friendship and fatherhood, Cantona and Ferguson's testimonies reveal how a man misread as hostile and unknowable was finally understood, loved, and forgiven, by the strictest disciplinarian in football. 
 
The film is directed and produced by David Tryhorn & Ben Nicholas (Pelé, El Caso Figo, Untold: Vinnie Jones); written and produced by Stevan Riley (Fire in Babylon; Listen to Me Marlon); and complemented by a pulsating original electronic score by dance music pioneer Paul Hartnoll of Orbital.
 
Featuring: Eric Cantona, Sir Alex Ferguson, Albert Cantona, Léonor Cantona, Guy Roux, Sir David Beckham
Directed and produced by: David Tryhorn and Ben Nicholas
Written and produced by: Stevan Riley
Produced by: Sean Richard
 
Universal Documentaries: Journey through powerful, award-winning documentaries that explore unmissable stories from across the world.

From athletes to artists, this channel focuses on those who achieved the pinnacle, and what it took to get them there. Join us as we journey through the highs and lows of success, the price of fame and the taste of victory in these award winning exploratory documentaries. 

Subscribe here: https://goo.gl/8UHnki

snippet.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Final Trailer Reaction - Cyclops Gets His Moment!
snippet.description:
The Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men are assembling for the end of everything.

Hector and Adam react to the final trailer for Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday! The new footage reveals Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter’s son, brings the Fantastic Four into Steve’s timeline, and gives us our biggest look yet at Doctor Doom’s multiversal war.

We break down Cyclops finally declaring, “To me, my X-Men,” the return of Marvel’s original mutant team, the alliance between the Avengers and New Avengers, and the massive battle against Doom and his Sentinels. Can Earth’s Mightiest Heroes survive when entire universes begin colliding?

In our discussion, we debate whether making Doctor Doom a variant of Tony Stark was the right creative choice and how that decision could affect the Marvel Cinematic Universe moving forward. We also explain why Doom should be more than a one-time Avengers villain, how he could remain a major presence throughout the MCU, and how Doomsday may set the stage for Secret Wars and the eventual merging of multiple universes into one.

Avengers: Doomsday arrives exclusively in theaters December 18, 2026.

snippet.title: wait, that was kinda good?!
snippet.description:
🎬 In this FilmSpeak video essay, we discuss the final Avengers Doomsday trailer and how it was kinda good?!
🔔 SUBSCRIBE: https://youtube.com/filmspeak?sub_confirmation=1

The final Avengers: Doomsday trailer is here and… honestly? That was kinda good?! With Chris Evans returning as Steve Rogers, Marvel finally gives us a clearer sense of what its next Avengers movie could actually be about. Beneath the reunions, Doctor Doom, and the return of the original X-Men cast, there’s the possibility of a story about imperfect heroes, the burden of their legacy, and the dangers of returning to a world you’ve outgrown.

In this Avengers: Doomsday trailer breakdown and reaction, FilmSpeak examines Steve Rogers’ return, his relationship with his son, and why reuniting him with Thor could give the film some much-needed emotional weight. From the Fantastic Four and Doom to Sam Wilson’s Captain America and the Thunderbolts’ New Avengers, these characters could bring Marvel’s post-Endgame identity crisis into focus. Could bringing back the legacy cast help the MCU confront its obsession with recreating its past?

But there’s still plenty giving me pause, especially Doom’s characterization, Sam’s absence from the spotlight, and the hollow nostalgia of that Cyclops moment. The Russo Brothers have delivered the strongest sales pitch for Avengers: Doomsday yet. The question is whether the movie will actually follow through on the ideas this trailer suggests.

snippet.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY FINAL TRAILER REACTION! (I CRIED OMG)
snippet.description:
AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY (2026) FINAL TRAILER REACTION! Zach Pope Reviews reacts to Chris Evans returning as Steve Rogers, his emotional moments with his son, Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom, and Marvel Studios bringing together the Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men!

THIS AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY TRAILER MADE ME EMOTIONAL AS A FATHER.

I was expecting INSANE action, Doctor Doom, massive crossovers, and some incredible Marvel moments.

BUT STEVE ROGERS AND HIS SON?!

THAT'S WHAT GOT ME.

We've watched Steve Rogers sacrifice so much throughout the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He was always willing to put the world before himself. And at the end of AVENGERS: ENDGAME, he finally got his chance to live the life he deserved with Peggy Carter.

Now we're seeing him as a FATHER.

And as a dad myself, there's something about that which hit me harder than I expected.

Steve Rogers isn't just fighting for the world anymore. He's a man with a family, a son, and something deeply personal to protect. Seeing that side of a character I've followed for so many years reminded me why these Marvel movies can be so powerful.

THE EMOTIONAL STAKES MATTER!

IN MY AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY FINAL TRAILER REACTION:
• Why Steve Rogers and his son made me emotional as a father
• Chris Evans returning as Captain America / Steve Rogers
• Steve and Peggy Carter's life after Avengers: Endgame
• How becoming a parent changes the meaning of heroism and sacrifice
• Robert Downey Jr. returning to Marvel as Doctor Doom
• The enormous stakes of the multiverse collapsing
• The Avengers, New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men
• James Marsden returning as Cyclops and the epic X-Men moments
• The Russo brothers returning after Infinity War and Endgame
• Why character-driven storytelling is just as important as the biggest action scenes
• Whether Avengers: Doomsday can deliver another unforgettable cinematic event

AND DON'T GET ME WRONG...

THE REST OF THIS TRAILER IS ABSOLUTELY MASSIVE!

ROBERT DOWNEY JR. AS DOCTOR DOOM!
THE FANTASTIC FOUR!
THE ORIGINAL X-MEN!
THE AVENGERS COMING TOGETHER!

I am SO excited for the spectacle and the incredible character interactions. But the thing that makes me believe this movie could be something special is how personal the story feels.

We've spent years growing alongside these heroes. Now we're seeing them face questions about family, legacy, love, and what they're willing to sacrifice to protect the people who matter most.

That's what I need from DOOMSDAY.

Not just insane cameos and action.

HEART. CONSEQUENCES. REAL EMOTION.

Directed by Joe and Anthony Russo, AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY arrives exclusively in theaters DECEMBER 18, 2026.

OFFICIAL MOVIE PAGE:
https://movies.disney.com/avengers-doomsday

LET'S DISCUSS:
Did Steve Rogers and his son make YOU emotional?
How do you feel about Steve becoming a father?
What's your favorite moment from the final trailer?
Are you most excited for Doctor Doom, the Avengers, Fantastic Four, or X-Men?
Can Doomsday match the emotional impact of Infinity War and Endgame?

snippet.title: Modders Got GTA 6 Booting on PC Overnight…
snippet.description:
GTA 6's missing .exe dropped two hours early on Monday. About an hour later, a fan project put the game's first frame on a PC. By evening there were menus at 30 fps, and before midnight a loaded world. The same night, the biggest project of them all, Leonida, lost its Discord server to a copyright notice, and 40 minutes later its founder, ItsNotRexed, posted five words: "I quit guys. I'm sorry."

This is the day-one update: what actually boots on PC and what doesn't, why the game shuts itself down 30 seconds into the open world, who really took Leonida down (the evidence is two HTTP status codes), which projects to watch now, and what to expect this week.

Chapters:
0:00 Monday
0:35 The file
1:54 The picture
4:08 The wall
5:14 The crowd
6:51 The night it vanished
9:01 What happens next
11:16 Thank you

Which project shows the open world first: VIctory or XCL?

This video doesn't show leaked gameplay, files, extracted assets or story text, doesn't link to the leak or to any download, and isn't a guide to running anything. Nothing can play GTA 6 on PC today, and anything with "GTA 6 PC" in its name that says otherwise is bait.

ABOUT WHAT'S ON SCREEN
• Facts are as of November 24, 2026, about 05:00 UTC.
• The file went up at about 14:36 UTC on Nov 23, 2 h 24 min before the leaker's countdown ended (17:00 UTC).
• The "first frame" (XCL, 15:44 UTC) was a black one. Menus reached 30 fps at 20:47 UTC. VIctory's commit that loads the world is from 22:10 UTC, and its title card from 00:02 UTC Nov 24. Nobody has player control.
• What a PC showed is redrawn as plain windows. All GTA VI footage is Rockstar's own trailers or retail console captures by the channels credited on screen. Nothing on screen comes from the leak.
• "587 functions, 432 already on Windows" is Leonida's own count of the file's imports; other projects count differently.
• 38 seconds against a 30-second watchdog: VIctory's own measurements of the first launch (1.4 s once cached).
• Leonida had 33,146 GitHub stars when the repository went. "179,000 Discord members" is a reported figure.
• Discord's notice cites copyright infringement and does not say who complained. "Rockstar taking the server down" is ItsNotRexed's own reading. No company has commented. GitHub answered 404, not 451, and its public takedown log had no notice for Leonida at 05:00 UTC.
• ItsNotRexed is a high-school student who built the biggest project of the race in three days. Be kind.
• The London sentence (seven years, released on licence the same day) is as reported by RTÉ and others.
• 3,077 public forks of Leonida were on GitHub at 04:47 UTC Nov 24.
• "Bring your own files does not automatically shield the user" is from Take-Two's Nov 18 takedown notices, which were about GTA V ports.

SOURCES
• GitHub: ivall/xcl (commits, issue #280, PR #283, README) · Marvisak/VIctory (commits, README) · Xbox2Windows · brcly/TuxBox · ThatRecompDev/five-star-recomp · the forks and continuations of ItsNotRexed/Leonida
• GitHub: github/dmca (Take-Two notices, Nov 18, 2026) · RFC 7725 (HTTP 451)
• ItsNotRexed's public posts of Nov 23-24, and Discord's notice as he posted it
• Trackers: gta6-pc-race, PortWatch VI · Reddit: r/pcmasterrace
• Take-Two's DMCA subpoenas to Discord and Microsoft (S.D.N.Y., Aug 2026), via VGC and TorrentFreak · RTÉ on the London sentencing
• Footage: Rockstar Games (Trailer 1, Trailer 2, the launch trailer, the GTA V trailer) · Isaac4K Gaming · MotoGamesTV · Skycaptin5 · ThirstyHyena · AFGuidesHD · Tourist Mode · Dreamscape Gaming · Fazzy Gaming · Cinema Gaming Lounge · GaMe LoVeRS · Cosmin Trica · Isaac97 · GrandTheftBrian · CrushZz · Jegs TV · BBPHOENIX · TronicsFix · Valve · Pexels

#GTA6 #GTA6PC #Leonida

snippet.title: Rockstar Is in Huge Trouble
snippet.description:
GTA 6 sold an estimated $3.79 billion at retail on its first day, more than any entertainment launch ever. On that same day, Take-Two's stock closed down 3.7%. So is Rockstar in trouble, or did the market just see this coming years ago?

In this essay I go through the stock chart one day at a time, how Take-Two really makes its money (recurring spending was 81% of its net bookings last quarter), and the arguments on both sides: the 30fps fight, GTA+ perks in single player, how GTA Online recovered from its broken 2013 start, and what happened to Red Dead Online. At the end there's the one thing GTA 5 got right in 2013 that GTA 6 still hasn't done.

Will the hype last until GTA 6 Online shows up? Tell me in one word in the comments: YES or NO.

0:35 The launch everyone saw coming
2:29 Priced in years ago
4:33 How Rockstar actually gets paid

localized.title: Rockstar Is in Huge Trouble
localized.description:
GTA 6 sold an estimated $3.79 billion at retail on its first day, more than any entertainment launch ever. On that same day, Take-Two's stock closed down 3.7%. So is Rockstar in trouble, or did the market just see this coming years ago?

In this essay I go through the stock chart one day at a time, how Take-Two really makes its money (recurring spending was 81% of its net bookings last quarter), and the arguments on both sides: the 30fps fight, GTA+ perks in single player, how GTA Online recovered from its broken 2013 start, and what happened to Red Dead Online. At the end there's the one thing GTA 5 got right in 2013 that GTA 6 still hasn't done.

Will the hype last until GTA 6 Online shows up? Tell me in one word in the comments: YES or NO.
